이 제품은 나이아신 50mg, 비타민 A 400μg, 비타민 B1 50mg, 비타민 B12 20μg, 비타민 B2 40mg, 비타민 B6 40mg, 비타민 C 210mg, 비타민 E 102mg, 엽산 240μg, 판토텐산 250mg를 표시량으로 담은 10원료 복합 건강기능식품입니다. 각 원료의 공식 인정 기능성은 아래와 같습니다.

왜 이 제품인가

  • 1일 2회(1정) 섭취로 나이아신 50mg, 비타민 A 400μg, 비타민 B1 50mg, 비타민 B12 20μg, 비타민 B2 40mg, 비타민 B6 40mg, 비타민 C 210mg, 비타민 E 102mg, 엽산 240μg, 판토텐산 250mg
  • 대장균군 음성 — 식약처 신고 기준 적합
  • 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 진한 노랑의 장방형 제피정제 · 우리바이오(주) 제조

  • 비타민 E
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
  • 엽산
    • 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요
    • 세포와 혈액생성에 필요

아드 파워 밸런스Niacin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 우리바이오(주) · 2 times a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 50mg of Niacin, 400μg of Vitamin A, 50mg of Vitamin B1, 20μg of Vitamin B12, 40mg of Vitamin B2, 40mg of Vitamin B6, 210mg of Vitamin C, 102mg of Vitamin E, 240μg of Folate, 250mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (1 tablet): 50mg Niacin, 400μg Vitamin A, 50mg Vitamin B1, 20μg Vitamin B12, 40mg Vitamin B2, 40mg Vitamin B6, 210mg Vitamin C, 102mg Vitamin E, 240μg Folate, 250mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 우리바이오(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
